# Frequently Asked Questions

## Sequential document numbers

### Can I have an offset for my automatically generated document numbers?

At the moment there is no built-in way to offset document numbers.

The sequential number is generated by counting the documents of a given type (i.e. invoice, offer) in the database - and then adding 1 to the highest number found.

The sum includes documents that have been deleted. A valid workaround for an offset would be to create deleted dummy documents with the desired offset.

### Best workflow for document drafts?

Currently document drafts are on the roadmap, but are not supported yet.

A document number is assigned once you save an invoice or offer. It is then immediately applied and the status of the document is pending.

The recommended workaround at this time is to create an offer first and then fully convert it to an invoice once you are ready to send the invoice.
